title: Likelihood-Based Inference for Time Series Extremes
text: lite package performs likelihood-based inference stationary time series extremes. general approach follows Fawcett Walshaw (2012). 3 independent parts inference. Bernoulli (pu) model whether given observation exceeds threshold \(u\). generalised Pareto, GP (σu,ξ), model marginal distribution threshold excesses. \(K\)-gaps model extremal index \(\theta\), based inter-exceedance times. parts 1 2 necessary adjust inferences expect data exhibit cluster dependence. achieved using methodology developed Chandler Bate (2007) produce log-likelihood adjusted dependence. achieved using chandwich package. part 3, methodology described Süveges Davison (2010) used, implemented function kgaps exdex package. (adjusted) log-likelihoods parts 1, 2 3 combined make inferences return levels. illustrate main functions lite using cheeseboro wind gusts data exdex package, contains hourly wind gust data January 10-year period 2000-2009.

title: lite: Likelihood-Based Inference for Time Series Extremes — lite-package
text: Performs likelihood-Based inference stationary time series extremes. general approach follows Fawcett Walshaw (2012). Marginal extreme value inferences adjusted cluster dependence data using methodology Chandler Bate (2007), producing adjusted log-likelihood model parameters.  log-likelihood extremal index produced using K-gaps model Suveges Davison (2010). log-likelihoods combined make inferences return levels.
